title: HelperFSWriteParams
description: Params of the helper fs service's write op: one chunk of a session's stream. A session is a stream and not a sparse file, so offset must equal the number of bytes already written; anything else is refused `bad-offset`. The data is base64 on the wire because Go's []byte marshals that way, and its decoded length is bounded by the transport's frame rather than by a product decision — a chunk above 256 KiB is refused `too-large` because it could not arrive.

id.description: The session id write-open was given.

offset.description: The first byte of this chunk: exactly the number of bytes the session already holds.

data.description: The chunk's bytes, base64. Empty is legal and answers the same size, which is what a caller that has nothing left to send can do without opening a second op.
